claims.scope: centered minimum-dimensional all-block ratio-critical cores satisfying fleet03/B20 low-J diffusion; influence-proportional index selector and deterministic block-label coarsening
claims.statement: If L=log2(1/J), p_i=q_i/J, max_i p_i<=c0/L with c0=2/ln2, and A=Phi(I) has label multiplicity m, then H2(I)>=log2(L/c0) when positive and H2(A)>=max(0,log2(L/(m c0))).

claims.statement: At every such node ref_v>=max(0,log2(log2(1/J_v)/(m_v c0))); summing with reach probabilities is bounded above by H2(Theta)-E H2(Theta|leaf)<=H2(Theta).

dependencies.result: posterior selector refund identity and telescope

claims.scope: genuine d-dimensional one-point-defect Boolean family; uniformly randomized singleton block selector
claims.statement: For q=2^(1-d), J=dq, choosing A={I} with I uniform gives H2(A)=log2 d, D_A=q, C_A=W_A=0 and U_A=h2(q). Hence for every fixed finite K, U_A+H2(A)<=K D_A fails for all sufficiently large d; with admitted Theta=I the posterior refund equals log2 d exactly. This refutes only a free randomized selector payment, not FEI.
